Product Detail: 

Introducing our latest innovation in hand protection: the Gardening & Household Work Gloves. These gloves are meticulously crafted by a global leader in leather safety goods, combining exceptional materials and thoughtful design to provide unparalleled comfort, durability, and functionality. Perfect for a wide range of tasks, from gardening to household chores, these gloves are designed to make your work easier, safer, and more enjoyable.

Gardening & household work Gloves Key Features:

Polyester Woven Grey Dotted Fabric: The gloves feature high-quality polyester woven grey dotted fabric on both the front and back. This fabric is chosen for its excellent grip and durability. The dotted design enhances traction, allowing you to securely handle tools and materials, reducing the risk of slipping and ensuring safer handling.

Polyester Woven Grey Fabric in Cut & Sew Area: Reinforced with polyester woven grey fabric in the cut and sew areas, these gloves offer additional strength and resilience. This material provides enhanced protection and flexibility, allowing you to perform tasks with greater precision and comfort.

Black Rib Band: The gloves are finished with a black rib band that offers a snug and comfortable fit. The elastic rib band ensures that the gloves stay securely in place during use, preventing dirt and debris from entering and keeping your hands clean and protected.

Ergonomic Fit: These gloves are designed to conform to the natural shape of your hands, providing an ergonomic fit that minimizes hand fatigue. This thoughtful design allows for extended use without discomfort, enabling you to work efficiently and comfortably for longer periods.

Easy On and Off: The black rib band not only ensures a secure fit but also makes it easy to put on and take off the gloves. This practical feature enhances the overall convenience and user-friendly design of the gloves.

Versatile Applications:

Gardening: Perfect for all your gardening needs, these gloves are ideal for planting, weeding, pruning, and other outdoor tasks. The durable polyester woven fabric and excellent grip ensure you can tackle any gardening challenge with ease and confidence.

Household Work: These gloves are also great for a wide range of household chores. Whether you're cleaning, organizing, or handling various tasks around the house, they provide the protection and dexterity you need to work efficiently and safely.

Product Specifications

Material: Polyester woven grey dotted fabric, polyester woven grey fabric in cut & sew area, black rib band

Color: Grey with black accents

Care Instructions:

To maintain the quality and performance of Our Gardening & Household Work Gloves, follow these care instructions:

Cleaning: Gently wipe off any dirt or debris with a damp cloth. For a more thorough cleaning, use mild soap and water. Avoid using harsh chemicals or abrasive materials to protect the integrity of the fabric.

Drying: Allow the gloves to air dry naturally, away from direct heat sources and sunlight. Do not wring or tumble dry to preserve the elastic properties of the rib band.

Storage: Store the gloves in a cool, dry place when not in use. This will help maintain their shape and extend their lifespan, ensuring they remain in top condition for your next use.

Our Gardening & Household Work Gloves are the perfect choice for anyone seeking reliable, comfortable, and versatile hand protection. Combining durable polyester woven grey dotted fabric with an ergonomic design and reinforced areas for added strength, these gloves offer the durability and flexibility needed for a wide range of gardening and household tasks.
